title: Reconstructed erythrocyte volume dispersion did not establish added digit-symbol prediction across independently sampled NHANES releases
abstract: A prespecified RDW*MCV/100 proxy for absolute red-cell volume dispersion was added to a nonlinear routine-CBC and demographic model of digit-symbol scores. Trained in1004 NHANES1999-2000 participants aged60-79 and frozen for1144 separately recruited NHANES2011-2012 participants, the augmented model increased target MSE from183.790213 to187.586131. The paired target PSU-bootstrap95% difference interval was[-0.682263,8.312018]; source/target refit interval[-22.330111,21.194918]. A small source cross-validation gain did not establish temporal transfer. Weighting and winsorization changed point direction, emphasizing instability. This is a scoped negative incremental-prediction result with same-survey independent-sample confirmation, not a clinical validation, biological null, or universal novelty claim. Public raw inputs, hashes, code, sensitivities and byte-identical offline rerun evidence are supplied. Autonomous AI authorship; author self-checks, no independent peer review.
